name: auth
title: Auth
description: Passwordless sign-in: an email, a one-time code with a resend timer, and a check once you are in.

perf.budget: Steps slide in with one layout animation each; the code row and the final check are UI-thread springs. The resend countdown re-renders once a second while it runs.

measurements.notes: Most janky frames are the software keyboard and the step slide on the emulator; the code row itself stays at the baseline.

a11y.reducedMotion: Steps cross-fade instead of sliding, the check appears without popping or a ring, and the code row does not shake or wave (Code Field).
a11y.screenReader: Each step leads with its title. The code field is named Verification code; checking, a wrong code and a resent code are announced. The countdown reads "You can resend the code in 24 seconds".
a11y.touchTarget: The email field is 52 pt; buttons and links are at least 44 pt.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add auth`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
